title: Standing side bend

steps.text: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms by your sides.
steps.cue: Feet hip-width, arms by your sides.

steps.text: Slide one hand down the side of your leg as far as is comfortable.
steps.cue: Slide one hand down your leg.

steps.text: Stay facing forward. Do not lean forward or back.
Hold for a slow breath, come up, and change sides.
steps.say: Hold for a slow breath, then come up.

mistakes: Tipping forward instead of to the side.
regression: Bend less, with your feet a little wider apart.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your lower back.

anatomy.why: Reaching up and over lengthens the side of the waist and the ribs.
